The [[Keeper of Shadows]] is one of the [[Forgotten]] collectors who award [[Forgotten weapon]]s in exchange for a [[Book of Secrets]], the [[Nightfall]] end-game reward item. 

==Location==
*[[Realm of Torment]]
**{{NPC location|Throne of Secrets}}

==Dialogue==
:''"Ah, the conquering hero who slew [[Abaddon]]. Your name will become legend in this world... and beyond. It would be my honor to create my finest art for you. Please, allow me this courtesy. Before I can create my masterpiece, I must have materials. If you bring me 1 Book of Secrets, I will fashion for you a creation the like of which this world has never known...."''
